get.description: Returns the Meta ad accounts linked to the page for Marketing Messages. This is the only Marketing Message endpoint that does not require `ad_account_id` — call it first to discover the ad account IDs used by all other endpoints.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Access token of the page used for authentication.

get.description: Lists the marketing messages stored for the page, newest first, each with its fresh campaign status from Meta. Set `get_insights=true` to also merge Meta delivery insights into each message.

parameters.name: cursor_after
parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: get_insights
parameters.description: If true, merge Meta delivery insights into each message. Default false.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON array of filter objects, e.g. [{"field":"message_type","operator":"EQUAL","value":"FREEFORM"}]. Supported: field=message_type operator=EQUAL/NOT_EQUAL; field=search operator=CONTAINS.

cursor_after.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

post.description: Creates a FREEFORM marketing message campaign on the linked ad account. A daily budget is required. The campaign is created in a processing state (status IN_PROCESS) and persisted asynchronously.

body.description: The message definition. May be a JSON object or a JSON-encoded string.

budget.description: Daily budget in the account currency (converted to fractional units server-side). Required.

currency.description: Auto-filled from the ad account if omitted.

start_date.description: Campaign start time (unix). Defaults to now.

end_date.description: Campaign end time (unix). Defaults to 30 days from now.

status.description: Initial status, e.g. PAUSED (default) or ACTIVE.

message_type.description: Creative layout: single (default), carousel, or text.

greeting_text.description: Greeting shown above the message content.

body.description: Message cards. Each card: headline, body_text, uploaded_media ([{ type, image_hash | video_id, image_url }]), buttons ([{ text, link }]).

body.headline: Big April Sale
body.body_text: Get up to 15% off this week only.

requestBody.description: `ad_account_id` is sent as a query parameter (see path-level parameters). The request body carries the message definition under `body`.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Access token of the page used for authentication.

get.description: Fetches a single marketing message by ID, including its fresh status from Meta. Returns `{ success: false, message: "Message not found" }` when the message does not exist.

delete.description: Deletes a marketing message campaign from Meta and removes it from Botcake.

parameters.name: current_message_name
parameters.description: Optional — current name, recorded in the audit log.

parameters.name: current_message_status
parameters.description: Optional — current status, recorded in the audit log.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Access token of the page used for authentication.

put.description: Changes the status of a marketing message campaign on Meta. Setting `new_status=ACTIVE` also activates the underlying campaign and ad set. The response reports `status` as IN_PROCESS while Meta applies the change.

new_status.description: Target status. One of: ACTIVE, PAUSED, IN_PROCESS, WITH_ISSUES, CAMPAIGN_PAUSED, PENDING_REVIEW, DISAPPROVED, PREAPPROVED, ARCHIVED, DELETED. Typically ACTIVE or PAUSED.

parameters.description: Ad account ID (act_...) to sync from.

post.description: Triggers a background job that re-imports the page's marketing messages from Meta for the given ad account. Returns immediately; the sync completes asynchronously.

value.message: Start sync marketing messages from Meta

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: If provided, returns delivery insights for this single message. Otherwise a paginated list is returned.

parameters.name: cursor_after
parameters.description: List mode only. Cursor for the next page.

parameters.name: get_insights
parameters.description: Defaults to true for this endpoint. Set false to skip insights.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: List mode only. Same format as List Marketing Messages.

get.description:
Returns marketing messages with Meta delivery insights merged in. When `message_id` is supplied, returns that one message (Example 1). Otherwise returns a paginated list with insights (Example 2).

Insight fields added when available: marketing_messages_delivered, marketing_messages_link_btn_click, marketing_messages_spend, marketing_messages_read_rate, marketing_messages_link_btn_click_rate, marketing_messages_cost_per_link_btn_click, marketing_messages_cost_per_delivered, date_start, date_stop, currency.

cursor_after.description: Present in list mode. Cursor for the next page.

get.description: Returns the marketing message custom audiences stored for the page and ad account, newest first, with a cached subscription-token count for each.

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: Filters by audience id, name, or description (case-insensitive contains).

post.description: Creates a new marketing message custom audience on Meta and stores it locally. After creation, Botcake automatically schedules a subscription-token sync (~15 minutes later). Returns `{ success: false, message: "name is required" }` when `name` is missing.

parameters.name: ad_account_id
parameters.description: Ad account ID (act_...) to sync from.

post.description: Triggers a background job that re-imports the page's custom audiences from Meta for the given ad account. Returns immediately; the sync completes asynchronously.

value.message: Start sync custom audiences from Meta

parameters.description: Access token of the page used for authentication.

post.description: Sends a marketing message to a single subscriber via the Meta Marketing Messages API. The recipient is identified either by `subscription_token` or by a customer `psid` — provide exactly one.

response.description: Raw response from the Meta send call.

marketing_message_id.description: ID of the marketing message to send.

message.description: Message payload to deliver (Messenger message object, e.g. { "text": "..." }).

subscription_token.description: Subscriber's subscription token. Provide this or psid.

psid.description: Customer PSID. Resolved to a subscription token server-side. Provide this or subscription_token.

parameters.name: broadcast_id
parameters.description: ID of the broadcast. Must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: access-token
parameters.description: Access token of the page used for authentication.

failed.description: Failed deliveries (includes marketing messages still undelivered after 24h)

total_phone_number.description: Count of recipients with a phone number

message.description: Error message, present when success is false.

get.description:
Returns aggregated delivery statistics for a broadcast. The base fields are returned for every platform (Example 1). WhatsApp Business pages additionally return order/revenue and reply metrics: total_orders, total_revenue, currency, total_replied, total_amount (Example 2).

An invalid or non-existent broadcast_id returns HTTP 200 with { success: false, message: "Invalid broadcast_id" } (Example 3).
